title: H1437 (2020 Regular): Safety of Religious Institutions

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Comm Sub, 2020-01-29; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2020/1437/BillText/c1/PDF (LegiScan doc 2115528))
provenance.note: Version read is the committee substitute (CS/HB 1437, 2020-01-29); not the enrolled text, no passage vote listed. In (b), "shall" struck and "may" added before "not be prohibited".

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): (12)(b) A person licensed under this section may not be prohibited from carrying or storing a firearm in a vehicle for lawful purposes.
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): (c)1. Notwithstanding ss. 790.06(12)(a)10. and 790.115, for the purposes of safety, security, personal protection, or other lawful purposes, a church, synagogue, or any other religious institution may authorize a person licensed under this section to carry a firearm on property owned, rented, leased, or lawfully used by the church, synagogue, or other religious institution.
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): 2. A property owner who rents, leases, or otherwise allows a church, synagogue, or other religious institution to use his or her property may, as a condition of use, prohibit the church, synagogue, or other religious institution from authorizing a person licensed under this section to carry a firearm on the property.
